verdict.rationale: Datadog documents its own programmatic access path: a platform API authenticated with an API key header, plus official client libraries. That supports non-interactive automation. Its docs also mention CI-adjacent flows, such as launching instrumented apps with `ddtrace-run` and environment variables, and uploading coverage reports to block merges. Missing for 10: a documented official CLI or CI runner integration (e.g. pipeline actions or headless setup guides), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none), and hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the Datadog API to access the Datadog platform programmatically.
Authenticate to the API with an [API key](/account_management/api-app-keys/#api-keys) using the header `DD-API-KEY`.
Enable Agent Observability by running your application using the `ddtrace-run` command and specifying the required environment variables.
Upload coverage reports to Datadog, visualize coverage data for pull requests, and block merges based on configurable thresholds.
